scope: ARCH-QUAL-01 bounded qualification helper and complete invocation path.
resolutions: Named-key reader retains only three permitted local values; stdin carries private inputs, and the container reads four named inherited base values without environment enumeration.
Atomic receipt claim rejects replay and concurrent reuse before private input access.
Runtime identity, ownership and compiled adapter hash are checked before private reads; frozen helper bytes are read once, hashed and delivered unchanged.
CP82-TIME-01 resolved: shared host monotonic budget plus absolute remote deadline prevents delayed Docker startup from extending qualification time.
Strict total result validation admits only fixed fields, coherent booleans and safe enums; canonical phone shape rejects leading zero.

positions.performance: One public adapter call; at most three fixed HTTPS Graph GETs, two phone pages and existing 10-second request timeouts within the outer budget.
positions.elegance: The standalone launcher preserves the existing adapter and keeps transport, gating and receipt validation explicit.
positions.structuralSoundness: No Nest bootstrap, private-method bypass, validator weakening, fallback credential or product edit.

limits: Approval permits one bounded invocation only after a distinct consumed-once root live GO; this review does not issue that GO.
No live qualification result or product acceptance is claimed.
Token class and explicit expiry remain unknown; BU ownership and delivery remain untested.
